principles: Keep the live path deterministic even if the research loop becomes agentic.
Separate course-grade online portfolio benchmarks from industry-style alpha extensions.
Treat transaction costs, turnover, and risk controls as first-class components.
Generate artifacts that agents and human reviewers can both consume.

agent_roles.title: Feature and Experiment Agent
agent_roles.purpose: Propose new factors, data joins, and ablations for the research queue.

agent_roles.title: Validation Agent
agent_roles.purpose: Look for leakage, parameter overfit, benchmark drift, and unrealistic assumptions.

agent_roles.title: Risk and Constraints Agent
agent_roles.purpose: Review concentration, turnover, cost drag, and live trading guardrails.

agent_roles.title: Research Report Agent
agent_roles.purpose: Convert runs into short memos, experiment logs, and GitHub-friendly updates.

reference_inspirations: The Columbia proposal defines the online portfolio benchmark track.

proposal_core.regime_method: 20-day equal-weight realized volatility above or below the sample median

definition.name: Best Constant Rebalanced Portfolio
definition.description: Best constant rebalanced portfolio in hindsight.
definition.theory: Upper bound benchmark for regret against the best fixed portfolio.

definition.name: Equal Weight (1/n)
definition.description: Uniform rebalancing sanity check and robust naive benchmark.
definition.theory: No regret guarantee; strong empirical baseline in allocation studies.

definition.name: Exponentiated Gradient
definition.description: Multiplicative-weights portfolio update over the simplex.
definition.theory: Regret scales like O(sqrt(T log n)) against BCRP.

definition.name: Online Newton Step
definition.description: Second-order online update with curvature-aware adaptation.
definition.theory: For exp-concave log-wealth objectives, regret scales like O(n log T).

definition.name: Approximate Universal Portfolio
definition.description: Sampled Cover universal portfolio over constant rebalanced portfolios.
definition.theory: Asymptotically tracks BCRP; approximation quality depends on the sample budget M.

definition.name: Momentum
definition.description: Overweight the strongest recent performers over a rolling window.
definition.theory: No regret guarantee; tends to benefit in trending markets.

definition.name: Mean Reversion
definition.description: Rotate toward recent laggards in the expectation of reversal.
definition.theory: No regret guarantee; can benefit in choppy or oscillating markets.

definition.name: Rolling Ridge Alpha
definition.description: Cross-sectional ridge regression over transparent handcrafted features.
definition.theory: Industry-style linear alpha baseline with strong interpretability.

definition.name: Attention Sequence Alpha
definition.description: Lightweight attention forecaster over recent feature sequences.
definition.theory: Transformer-style sequence model extension inspired by modern quant research.

definition.name: Blended Alpha Portfolio
definition.description: Blend statistical and attention signals, then pass them through deterministic optimization.
definition.theory: Matches the research pattern used by many quant firms: alpha model plus optimizer plus risk control.

recommended_path: Use the proposal_core track as the coursework evaluation path.
Use the ml_extension track as the GitHub / industry extension path.
Paper trade before any live deployment and keep execution deterministic.
